name: functions
description: Sabha HQ server-side logic — custom claims, invites, and (later) callable check-in.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:invites: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project sabha-hq --only firestore,auth "node scripts/_smoke-test-invites.js"
scripts.test:checkin: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project sabha-hq --only firestore "node scripts/_smoke-test-checkin.js"
scripts.test:orgs: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project sabha-hq --only firestore,auth "node scripts/_smoke-test-createorg.js"
scripts.test:platform: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project sabha-hq --only firestore "node scripts/_smoke-test-platform.js"
scripts.test:events: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project sabha-hq --only firestore "node scripts/_smoke-test-events.js"
scripts.test:all: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project sabha-hq --only firestore,auth "node scripts/_smoke-test-migration.js && node scripts/_smoke-test-invites.js && node scripts/_smoke-test-checkin.js && node scripts/_smoke-test-createorg.js && node scripts/_smoke-test-platform.js && node scripts/_smoke-test-events.js"
